summary: The 57th expedition rides out in a long-range scouting formation. An Abnormal on the right wing is not wandering. It is hunting Eren.

segments.titleEn: The morning they leave the walls
segments.ja: 第五十七回の壁外調査が、朝の門から始まります。調査兵団の列は長く、新しく翼をつけた新兵の顔がところどころで硬いです。エレンは特別作戦班の中央近くに馬を置きます。リヴァイは多くを言いません。今日の仕事は、巨人を片端から討つことではない、とだけ確認します。長距離索敵陣形を保ち、異常があれば煙で伝え、中央を不用意に開けない。エレンはその配置の意味を、胸の熱として聞いていました。
segments.en: The 57th expedition beyond the walls began at the morning gate. The Survey Corps column was long, and here and there a new recruit's face, newly given wings, was stiff. Eren set his horse near the center of the Special Operations Squad. Levi did not say much. He only confirmed that today's work was not to cut down Titans from one end to the other. Keep the long-range scouting formation. If something is wrong, send it by smoke. Do not open the center carelessly. Eren heard the meaning of that arrangement as heat in his chest.

segments.ja: 長距離索敵陣形は、地図の上では美しい網です。右翼、左翼、前方、後方、そして中央。各班は遠く離れ、赤と黒の煙で危険の種類を伝えます。近くにいれば安心、という訓練の感覚は、ここでは使えません。遠くにいるからこそ、一箇所の死が全体を殺しません。ジャンはその広さに圧倒され、ライナーは右翼側で新兵の位置を押さえています。アルミンは煙の意味を頭の中で図にします。
segments.en: On a map, the long-range scouting formation is a beautiful net. Right wing, left wing, front, rear, and the center. Squads stay far apart and use red and black smoke to say what kind of danger it is. The training feeling that safety comes from being close does not work here. Because they are far apart, one death does not kill the whole body. Jean was overwhelmed by the width. Reiner, on the right, kept the recruits in place. Armin turned the meaning of the smoke into a diagram in his head.

segments.ja: 最初の異変は右翼から上がりました。黒煙が続き、赤が混じります。普通の巨人なら、人を見ればまっすぐ来ます。報告される一体は、そうではありません。速い、人の少ない方向を選ぶ、班を追って進路を変える。奇行種という言葉が、伝令の口を走ります。アルミンはその煙を見て、空腹の動きではないと感じました。何かを探して走っている。探す対象が、まだ中央にいるのかもしれない、と。
segments.en: The first trouble rose from the right wing. Black smoke continued, and red mixed in. An ordinary Titan, seeing a person, comes straight. The one in the reports did not. It was fast. It chose directions with fewer people. It changed course to follow a squad. The word Abnormal ran through the messengers' mouths. Looking at that smoke, Armin felt this was not the movement of hunger. It was running in search of something. The thing it wanted might still be at the center.

segments.ja: 接近した兵が、その巨人の形を伝えます。筋力が人に近く、顔立ちまで女の形に寄っている。女型の巨人、と現場は呼び始めました。皮膚の硬さ、走りの持久、腕の使い方。どれも既知の奇行種の欄に収まりません。ジャンは右翼の混乱を馬上で聞き、ライナーは新兵を後方へ下げようとします。中央のエレンには、まだ姿は見えません。見えないまま、自分のことだと感じてしまうのが、今日の配置の残酷さでした。
segments.en: Soldiers who got close reported the Titan's shape. Muscle like a human's, and a face that leaned toward a woman's. The field started calling it the Female Titan. Hardness of the skin. Endurance of the run. The way it used its arms. None of it fit the column of known Abnormals. From the saddle Jean heard the right wing coming apart. Reiner tried to drop the recruits toward the rear. At the center, Eren still could not see it. The cruelty of today's arrangement was feeling that it was about him while it was still invisible.

segments.ja: アルミンは右翼の被害を、点ではなく線として見ます。女型の巨人は、人を食うために止まらない。情報を持っていそうな班を狙い、中央の方向へ弧を描く。これは徘徊ではなく追跡です。追跡なら、目標はエレンの位置を知っているか、知ろうとしている。アルミンはその図を、届く範囲の上官に伝えます。信じてもらえるかは分かりません。図が正しいなら、索敵陣形は今、敵に読まれています。
segments.en: Armin saw the losses on the right not as dots but as a line. The Female Titan did not stop in order to eat. It aimed at squads that looked as if they held information, and it drew an arc toward the center. This was not wandering. It was pursuit. If it was pursuit, the target either knew where Eren was or was trying to learn. Armin passed that diagram to the officer he could reach. He did not know if it would be believed. If the diagram was right, the scouting formation was being read by the enemy.

segments.en: Commander Erwin did not stop the march when he heard the losses on the right. Was the point of scouting not zero casualties. Some recruits suspected exactly that. On Erwin's map, losses were also information. Where the Female Titan aimed. What it knew. Until he could see that line clearly, the formation could bend and the destination would not change. What looked like a cold march was, inside him, a calculation continuing toward the next forest. The forest had not been explained to the soldiers yet.

tokens.note: The officer in charge of a regiment. Erwin is Commander of the Survey Corps.

segments.titleEn: The speed of a knowing face
segments.ja: 女型の巨人の動きを近くで見た兵は、もう一つの異常を報告します。格闘の形が、訓練で見る人間の技に似ている。巨人の本能だけでは説明しにくい、目的のある打撃です。アルミンはその報告を、自分の図の最後の線として受け取ります。これは奇行種ですらないかもしれない。人間の知識を持った巨人だ。知識があるなら、壁の内側に協力者がいる可能性まで、今日の遠征は拾ってしまいました。中央のエレンは、まだその結論を知りません。
segments.en: Soldiers who saw the Female Titan up close reported one more abnormality. The shape of its fighting resembled human technique from training. Strikes with a purpose, hard to explain by instinct alone. Armin took that report as the last line of his diagram. This might not even be an Abnormal. It might be a Titan holding a human's knowledge. If it had knowledge, today's expedition had also picked up the possibility of a partner inside the walls. Eren at the center did not know that conclusion yet.

segments.ja: 日は傾き、右翼の煙は切れません。ジャンとライナーは生き残った新兵をまとめ、陣形の穴を埋める位置へ戻ろうとします。アルミンは図を抱えたまま、中央へ伝える道を探します。エレンは馬上で自分の手を見ます。切れても巨人にならなかった朝と、今切れば敵に見つかる午後。どちらの条件も、彼の意思だけでは選べません。女型の巨人の弧は、まだ森の前で閉じていませんでした。
segments.en: The day leaned, and the smoke on the right wing did not stop. Jean and Reiner gathered the recruits who were still alive and tried to return to a place that would fill a hole in the formation. Armin, still holding the diagram, looked for a road that would carry it to the center. On his horse Eren looked at his own hand. The morning when a cut did not make a Titan, and the afternoon when a cut would show the enemy where he was. He could not choose either condition by will alone. The Female Titan's arc had not closed yet, in front of the forest.

segments.titleEn: The sound of leaving the gate
segments.ja: 門が開く音は、トロストの穴を塞いだ岩の音より高いものでした。調査兵団の列はその音のあとに広がり、長距離索敵陣形へ散っていきます。新兵は隣の馬が急に遠くなることに慣れません。エレンは中央で、散っていく同期の背中を一人ずつ見失います。リヴァイは見失うことを正しさとして扱います。近くに固まるな。固まった集団は、女型の巨人のような敵に一度で刈られる。エレンはその説明を、自分を守る配置であり、自分を餌にする配置でもあると理解しました。
segments.en: The sound of the gate opening was higher than the sound of the boulder that had plugged Trost's hole. After that sound the Survey Corps column spread into the long-range scouting formation. The recruits were not used to the horse beside them suddenly becoming far. At the center Eren lost the backs of his classmates one by one. Levi treated that losing sight as the correct act. Do not bunch up. A bunched group can be cut down at once by an enemy like the Female Titan. Eren understood the explanation as an arrangement that protected him and also as an arrangement that used him as bait.

segments.ja: 右翼の黒煙が続いたとき、一つの班の応答だけが途切れます。伝令は戻らず、赤煙も追加されません。途切れたことが、全滅の報告の代わりになります。ジャンはその空白を、自分の班の番号ではないと確認して、それでも胃が冷えるのを止められません。番号が違っても、同じ遠征の人間です。アルミンは空白を図に黒い点として置き、点の位置が中央へ寄っていないかを測ります。寄っているなら、敵は食う場所を選んでいません。進む先を選んでいます。
segments.en: When the black smoke on the right continued, only one squad's answer broke off. The messenger did not return, and no extra red smoke was added. The break itself stood in for a report of total loss. Jean checked that the blank was not his squad's number, and still could not stop his stomach going cold. A different number was still a person on the same expedition. Armin put the blank on the diagram as a black dot and measured whether the dot was leaning toward the center. If it was leaning, the enemy was not choosing a place to eat. It was choosing a direction to advance.

Whether to leave a person while it had not yet arrived was already the fight. Reiner's shoulder tilted under the recruit's weight and, still tilted, headed toward the next smoke.

segments.en: What reached Eren at the center was not a shape but a scream. Because of the wind, it did not become words. Nobody in the Special Operations Squad explained the sound. He understood later that not explaining was a technique for not shaking a recruit. For now he only pressed a nail into his palm. The urge to transform and the order not to transform grew larger by turns with every scream. Petra knew it, and she avoided looking at his hand. If she looked, she would see that he was asking permission. Permission existed only with the Captain.

segments.en: Today's words. The long-range scouting formation is the formation that spreads far out to see danger early. The right wing is the side that met the Female Titan first.
